title: Avon Health + Junction: Lab Ordering, Built In
summary: Avon Health has launched Junction's diagnostic infrastructure directly inside their EMR, giving providers a seamless way to order labs from Quest, Labcorp, BioReference, and more. No external portals. No delays. Just embedded lab workflows, powered by a single API.
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce that[Avon Health](https://avonhealth.com/) , a highly customizable EMR and practice platform, has officially launched with **Junction’s diagnostic infrastructure fully embedded** . This integration brings faster, cleaner lab ordering to providers across Avon’s network – with no external portals, no faxes, and no fragmented workflows. Now, Avon users can place lab orders with **Quest, Labcorp, BioReference** , and supported regional labs directly within their EMR, and receive results without leaving the system.


### **Built for Teams Who Value Time, Accuracy, and Flow**


Avon’s team knew what wasn’t working: external portals that break clinical focus, scattered lab integrations that slow down engineering teams, and workflows that force ops teams to do too much manual coordination. They came to us looking for something better – **real infrastructure** that could serve solo practices and fast-scaling care orgs alike, without compromising on compliance, coverage, or patient experience. With Junction, Avon was able to embed lab workflows directly into their platform without building everything from scratch. The result is a more seamless experience for providers, operations teams, and patients.


### **What Avon Customers Can Do Now**


With lab ordering powered by Junction, Avon customers can:


1. Order from labs like Quest, Labcorp, and BioReference
2. Route orders electronically, with no extra logins or platforms
3. Receive results in real time directly inside Avon
4. Track order status across the full lifecycle
5. Set up automations based on results
6. Order with third-party billing
7. Get access to thousands of nationwide PSCs – without needing to manage logistics manually


### **About Avon Health**


**Avon Health** is an AI-forward EMR and practice management system designed to launch fast, adapt to modern care models, and support everything from solo practices to large virtual-first organizations. With customizable modules, smart automations, and integrated AI features, Avon helps care teams work faster, stay more organized, and deliver a better experience – in-person and online.


### **About Junction**


**Junction** provides modern diagnostic infrastructure for healthcare platforms. With a single API, teams can embed lab ordering, fulfillment, and result tracking directly into their products. We handle the operational complexity so you don’t have to. From nationwide lab access to clean patient communications and billing workflows, we help platforms deliver diagnostic programs that are compliant, scalable, and easy to use.


### **Ready to See It in Action?**


If you’re an Avon customer, reach out to your rep to get lab ordering enabled. If you’re building your own care platform or modern EMR, we’d love to help you embed diagnostics—without reinventing the system.[Book a demo](https://cal.com/forms/65b79178-9911-4def-8b13-b3a5cb3f4031)
